## What is wrong?

Describe the problem. For a tool entry, include its crate name, category, and official URL.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the command or page involved and any relevant output.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe what should happen and what happened instead.

## Environment

For command failures, include your OS, Rust/Cargo versions, and the tool version.
For workflow failures, include the GitHub Actions run URL.

## Additional context

Include source links or screenshots if useful.
